recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It is a narrow cleanup of obsolete paths left by the already-published FHIR-40522 subject[x] to CodeableReference migration.
issue_request: FHIR-40522 was Published as Persuasive with Modification for R5. It asked that Definition.subject[x] repeat because a definition can apply to multiple subject types; the accepted resolution was to change the element to 0..* CodeableReference so resources can constrain to a concept or Group as appropriate.
initial_application: The issue had been partially applied by 125f3872df557d874280700b0c21c07d93dc2fc4, which changed Definition.subject[x] to Definition.subject with type CodeableReference(Group), and by 780848422c95aecca553449ce3f3f82fced81cf4, which changed cardinality from 0..1 to 0..*. Current source retained that main element change but still had old choice-style search paths and workflow mapping targets.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini lists definition under [logical], and PlanDefinition and Questionnaire are active resources. Confluence FHIR Workflow minutes for 2023-02-27 record FHIR-40522 as Persuasive w/ mod during a pattern-mapping discussion. No directly relevant Zulip discussion or later conflicting Jira issue was found.
reconciliation: Updated the Definition logical model search parameter paths from Definition.subjectCodeableConcept and Definition.subjectReference to Definition.subject.concept and Definition.subject.reference, and updated PlanDefinition.topic and Questionnaire.subjectType workflow mappings from Definition.subject[x] to Definition.subject.
